# Patterns for common spark-shared class files that must not be promoted to
# the root layout even when binary dedupe marks them bitwise-identical.
#
# Add entries only when a class must remain in the parallel-world layout
# for compatibility, packaging, or follow-up validation reasons. New common
# classes should normally stay unshimmed by default.

# These classes are intentionally not added to the compatibility waiver in
# binary-dedupe.sh. They looked executable-bytecode-compatible in the unshim
# investigation, but are not bitwise-identical across representative shim sets
# due to metadata, debug-info, or Spark API shape differences. Keep them in the
# parallel-world layout until they are refactored to be bitwise-identical or a
# dedicated ABI-compatibility verifier replaces the legacy waiver mechanism.
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuShuffleDependency.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/parquet/CloseableColumnBatchIterator.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/GpuReadCSVFileFormat.class
org/apache/spark/sql/catalyst/json/rapids/GpuReadJsonFileFormat.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/shims/PythonMapInArrowExecShims.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/execution/python/shims/PythonArgumentUtils.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/shims/GpuUnionExecShim.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuStringTrim.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuStringTrimLeft.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuStringTrimRight.class
org/apache/spark/sql/execution/datasources/v2/rapids/GpuAtomicCreateTableAsSelectExec$.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/shims/RapidsErrorUtils.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/execution/python/shims/WindowInPandasExecTypeShim.class
